program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((pivot (first (find-color g 2)))
         (pr (first pivot))
         (pc (second pivot)))
    (foldl (lambda (p out)
             (let* ((dr0 (- (first p) pr)) (dc0 (- (second p) pc))
                    (rots (list (list dr0 dc0) (list dc0 (- dr0)) (list (- dr0) (- dc0)) (list (- dc0) dr0))))
               (foldl (lambda (d acc)
                        (let ((nr (+ pr (first d))) (nc (+ pc (second d))))
                          (if (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                              (set-cell acc nr nc 1)
                              acc)))
                      out rots)))
           g (find-color g 1))))
